test_title: PYST 37: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice marked with the letters F, G, P, Q, R and S are shown.

Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter 'G'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5435f7a553bfd7b87e3b0868325dcb9f2335c59021248a558bbf46cff27fbef1.png]
solution:
In first and second dice P and Q are common in both dice.

Second dice is rotated 90⁰ anti-clockwise in vertically on the other adjacent side of P, Q is 'F'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45bb242acd8a79bf47472be8527a438b9aba5f5f23cc651cd74c818b0d2a0cb1.png] 

∴ Here, the opposite side of 'G' is 'F'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"F".**
